title: St Catherine prison hunger-strike allegations over Christmas 2020
notes: Reported by December 29 over Christmas holidays; SUFJ confirms some blocks while DCS denies occurrence. Inmates reportedly stayed in cells; no >=50 public gathering established. January persistence appears only in unverified blog/commentary leads. No January candidate duplicate; response to protest unknown.

start_date.summary: December 30 article refers to December 29 reporting and Christmas-holiday alleged action, not exact physical onset.

occurrence.summary: Human rights group and DCS disagree; independent investigation and January continuation evidence needed.
